# UI, design system and SEO profile

Read [root policy](../../AGENTS.md), use
[ui-frontend](../../.agents/skills/ui-frontend/SKILL.md), and inspect the relevant
[canonical SVG](../../docs/ui-wireframes/README.md) before screen changes.

Preserve approved hero composition, theme tokens, Material controls, responsive
containment and public/private metadata. Keep implementation terminology out of
product screens. UI changes do not authorize pricing, auth or contract changes.
Record actual browser/viewport/Axe evidence separately from compile-only checks.
